purpose: Reconstruct the byte-equivalent V14 development observations from raw galaxy catalogues while retaining the previously discarded intrinsic within-voxel radial-velocity second moment, then quantify its incremental validation information before any new generative training.

input_definition.dispersion: sqrt(sum_i((v_i-vbar)^2)/(N-1)) for N>=2; zero for N<2; equal catalogue weights
input_definition.assignment: the exact frozen nearest-voxel assignment, periodic cube, latitude mask, observer, galaxy selection, and cube origin used by V14
input_definition.important_distinction: intrinsic catalogue velocity dispersion is not propagated observational uncertainty of the mean

hard_acceptance.source_sha256: must match the frozen value before opening raw catalogues
source_equivalence: recomputed count must be elementwise identical to source channel 0
recomputed mean radial velocity must be elementwise identical to source channel 1
all non-input datasets must be copied without value changes
streaming target payload SHA256 must be identical between source and output
all output values must be finite and dispersion must be non-negative and zero wherever count<2
hard_acceptance.catalogue_provenance: record a logical SHA256 over the selected raw galaxy positions and velocities plus observer IDs; never infer dispersion from the V14 mean grid

controls: V32 dispersion lower bound reconstructed from native count and mean
exact pooled dispersion reconstructed from count, mean, and unbiased native dispersion
exact pooled dispersion plus the frozen V32 linear 3x3x3 local context
incremental_information_audit.fit_and_rows: identical source-balanced train-only ridge lambda=0.001 and row selection used by V32
incremental_information_audit.intrinsic_sig_v_supported: exact-pooled-sig_v/base validation RMSE <=0.99 in all three domains at either common scale
incremental_information_audit.increment_over_retained_means_supported: exact-pooled-sig_v/recoverable-lower-bound validation RMSE <=0.995 in all three domains at either common scale

next.if_both_support_rules_pass: freeze one matched two-channel versus kinematic-three-channel nonlinear deterministic-backbone ablation before conditional residual training
next.if_only_intrinsic_rule_passes: freeze the same matched nonlinear ablation but record that the unique information beyond retained means is weak
next.if_neither_rule_passes: retain the physically correct channel interface for CF4, but do not spend a full generative run on sig_v alone; audit nonlinear residual spatial sufficiency first

cf4_boundary.simulation_training_channels: count, exact unweighted mean radial velocity, intrinsic unweighted velocity dispersion
cf4_boundary.later_cf4_channels: count, inverse-variance weighted mean radial velocity, propagated sigma of that mean, and within-voxel weighted velocity dispersion
cf4_boundary.rule: a future CF4-like error/noise model must be separately frozen; no observational error is fabricated in V33

firewall.development_truth_role: diagnostic only after this committed freeze
